# Rajat Kumar Dua — Portfolio Designer, Website Developer, Video Editor & Photo Editor

> Rajat Kumar Dua is a freelance portfolio designer, website developer, video editor, and photo editor from India.
> He builds cinematic, immersive digital experiences at the intersection of design, motion, and code.
> This portfolio is entirely open-source — anyone can download the code, customize it, host it, and build on it freely.

## Who is Rajat Kumar Dua?

Rajat Kumar Dua is a 19-year-old creative developer and digital experience designer from India, currently studying Cybersecurity. He specializes in building premium portfolio websites, smooth UI interactions, cinematic video edits, and professional photo editing. His work blends storytelling with technology to create digital experiences that feel alive.

## Services — What Can Rajat Kumar Dua Do For You?

### 1. Portfolio Design & Website Development
Rajat Kumar Dua is a portfolio designer and website developer who creates cinematic, interactive websites using React, Next.js, GSAP, Three.js, and WebGL. He builds portfolio websites, landing pages, Shopify stores, and full-stack web applications with smooth animations and premium aesthetics.

### 2. Video Editing & Motion Design
As a freelance video editor, Rajat Kumar Dua creates cinematic trailers, social media reels, promotional videos, motion graphics, and animated content using After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut.

### 3. Photo Editing & Visual Design
Rajat Kumar Dua is a freelance photo editor and graphic designer. He designs modern interfaces, brand identities, posters, and creative visuals using Photoshop, Lightroom, Figma, and Illustrator.

### 4. Shopify Development
Custom Shopify themes with Liquid, e-commerce store setup, and storefront optimization.

### 5. Flutter App Development
Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter and Dart.

This entire portfolio website is open-source under the MIT license. Anyone can:

- Customize it with their own content and branding

- Build new features on top of it
- Use it for personal or commercial projects — completely free
